description: Maintain the local store and its dashboard mirror; health and conflicts only read. Database admin. snapshot creates unless listOnly=true; retention deletes oldest files. restore backs up then replaces the local store; shared stores refuse. purge deletes only the dashboard mirror. prune_snapshots previews unless confirmed; empties content, keeps rows, references and milestones. conflicts lists divergent shared fields; settle keeps one value. pull/clone retired: use reasonbook sync. backfill uploads owner stores; force is ignored; dryRun=true refuses retired replay.

confirm.description: Required to restore, purge or apply a snapshot prune

keepLast.description: Per context, keep 30 snapshots' content by default

keepSince.description: Keep snapshots from this date on

recordId.description: settle: the row id this copy shows

snapshotId.description: restore: required listed ID, not a path

name: rbook_db
title: Database administration
